source_extracts.label: FedEx SameDay service
source_extracts.quote: With FedEx SameDay® services, your time-sensitive shipments are delivered within hours, depending on flight availability.

source_extracts.label: FedEx SameDay drop-off limitation
source_extracts.quote: Same day shipments can’t be dropped off or picked up at FedEx® Drop Boxes, FedEx Office locations, FedEx OnSite locations, FedEx Ship Center® locations, or FedEx Authorized ShipCenters® (FASCs).

source_extracts.label: UPS Express Critical same-day service
source_extracts.quote: UPS Express Critical® is our same-day delivery service for urgent, time-sensitive, emergency or high-value goods.

source_extracts.label: UPS Express Critical transit time
source_extracts.quote: UPS Express Critical® is our fastest service with most shipments being delivered in 2 to 12 hours. Transit times vary based on the specific circumstances of each shipment and urgency to have it delivered.

source_extracts.label: USPS Priority Mail Express delivery estimate
source_extracts.quote: Priority Mail Express® service provides 1–3 day delivery service by 6 PM with a money–back guarantee1. You get competitive prices and fast delivery every day, all year, with limited exceptions, to most U.S. addresses and PO Boxes™3.

source_extracts.label: USPS Priority Mail Express delivery-date qualifier
source_extracts.quote: Scheduled delivery date depends on origin, destination, and drop-off time. Some restrictions apply.
